purpose.objective: Connect owned academy consumer surfaces to source-qualified canonical teacher/query results while preserving history, report hierarchy and exact workflow coverage.
successCriteria: CON-01 qualifies exact preserved MCP/context/installed-skill contracts without promoting historical saved scope into all/current history.
CON-02 connects date/class/student preparation and correction reporting to qualified QRY-02 using caller-owned authentication and bounded shared production transport.
CON-03 routes remaining intended internal workflow consumers or retains explicit unavailable scopes; no deferred surface is counted complete.
Full paging, UTF-8 byte bounds, refusal bounds, exact attempt/edition/occurrence joins and teacher-final preservation remain verified at changed production paths.
inScope: Owned source consumer glue, canonical result transport, report contracts and metadata context selection.
Metadata-only catalog currentness/references and synthetic fixtures; installed skill readback by allowed metadata/hash.
outOfScope: No publication, merge, deploy, native activation, real student source reads/writes, printing/sending or parent communication.
No common contracts/dependency pins/permissions, native config/credentials/services or unrelated Work changes.
No duplicated domain reducer or independently maintained common validator; no original source/history rewrite.
